items.text: Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3, a multimodal flow model unifying image, video and audio generation plus robot action prediction, with FLUX 3 Video making 20-second clips with native audio.
items.text_zh: Black Forest Labs 发布 FLUX 3 多模态流模型，统一图像、视频、音频生成与机器人动作预测，FLUX 3 Video 可一次生成带原生音频的 20 秒视频。

items.text: Cursor's upgraded agent swarm pairs frontier-model planners with cheaper worker models, hitting 100% test success rebuilding SQLite in Rust and suggesting most coding can be delegated to low-cost models.
items.text_zh: Cursor 升级的 agent swarm 让前沿模型做规划、廉价模型当执行者，在用 Rust 重写 SQLite 的任务中测试通过率达 100%，表明多数编码工作可下放给低价模型。

items.text: Otthein Herzog, a foreign academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, said AI's next breakthrough will come from collaboration among small intelligent agents.
items.text_zh: 中国工程院外籍院士赫尔佐格表示，AI 的下一个突破口是小型智能体之间的协作。

items.text: TechCrunch published an analysis making sense of the current panic over Chinese AI, examining how Chinese open-weight models' momentum is reshaping debates in Washington and Silicon Valley.
items.text_zh: TechCrunch 刊文解读当下对中国 AI 的恐慌情绪：中国开源权重模型的迅猛势头正在重塑华盛顿与硅谷的争论。

items.text: Nobel laureate economist Simon Johnson warned in an SCMP interview about China's 'over-automation' risks as the US-China AI race intensifies.
items.text_zh: 诺贝尔经济学奖得主 Simon Johnson 接受《南华早报》采访，谈美中 AI 竞赛升温之际中国面临的“过度自动化”风险。
